name: Skills Extended
teaser: Lack of skills is no longer a skill issue
description:
About

Skills Extended is back from its eternal nap—with more ways to put your skills to work.

Pick mechanical locks, hack electronic doors, and track hidden supply caches with a Modified PDA. Build your proficiency with weapons, medicine, stealth, and faction trading as you play.

Skills Extended adds or expands 12 skills, with three playable minigames and a web editor for customizing progression and bonuses across both extended and built-in skills.

  • Lock Picking: work individual pins and manage tension to open supported mechanical locks.
  • Hacking: explore a security network and defeat its defenses to bypass supported electronic doors.
  • Signals Intelligence: tune transmissions, collect bearings, and hunt down hidden supply caches.
  • Practice modes: learn all three activities outside a raid without spending equipment or changing your character’s progression.
  • Configuration: adjust bonuses, leveling speed, door difficulty, weapon lists, and signal cache content through your browser.
  • Fika integration: play together using the matching Skills Extended Fika addon.

Bonus values listed are the supplied defaults. Your server’s settings may change them.

Please report bugs through Mod Issues, rather than in the comments. Include your mod and SPT versions, whether you use Fika, relevant logs, and steps to reproduce the problem.

Want to support development? Buy me a coffee or visit my YouTube channel.

Installation
  1. Download the core package for your SPT version.
  2. Close the game and server before installing or updating.
  3. Extract the complete archive into your SPT installation folder, merging its BepInEx and SPT_Runtime folders with yours.
  4. Start the server, then launch the game normally.

Install the whole package: Skills Extended includes both client and server components.

Using Fika? Install the core package and matching Fika integration addon on the host and every player, including your headless host if you use one. Keep everyone’s core and addon versions matched, and update them together. Check the release requirements for the required SPT and Fika versions.

Config Editor

While your SPT server is running, open:

Skills Extended configuration editor

Use your server’s address and port if they differ from the default above. Sign in with an SPT administrator account to make changes.

The editor lets you:

  • Configure extended skills and supported built-in skill bonuses.
  • Adjust leveling speed globally or for individual skills, with a separate weapon mastery multiplier.
  • Edit weapon proficiency lists, mechanical lock settings, and hacking door difficulty.
  • Configure signal cache placements and rewards.
  • Edit profile skill levels.
  • Authorize individual Fika profiles to use the in-game placement editor.

Built-in bonus settings show their defaults and include Reset to default controls. Simply viewing a setting does not override it.

Leveling example: a global multiplier of 2× and an Endurance multiplier of 1.5× give 3× incoming Endurance gameplay XP. Weapon mastery has its own multiplier. Quest skill rewards and manual profile edits retain their stated values.

Save changes, then restart your game client to load updated client settings. In Fika, restart all connected game clients, including the headless host when used.

Use the F12 menu for local preferences such as minigame volume, lock-picking sensitivity, controls, and reduced motion.

Guides and Practice

New to the minigames? Open the illustrated guides while your server is running. No sign-in is required; substitute your server’s address and port if needed.

You can also open Character → Skills outside a raid and select Practice for Lock Picking, Hacking, or Signals Intelligence. Practice is available from the hideout’s Skills screen too.

Practice needs no equipment, consumes no items, and awards no XP. It defaults to your displayed skill level, with an option to try a different level inside the simulation. Disabled or locked skills have no practice button.

Lock-picking practice includes optional coaching, target gauges, and pin guidance. Turn coaching off to practice with normal raid-style feedback.

Lock Picking

Forgot the key? Craft a Lockpick set at Workbench level 1 and take it to a supported locked mechanical door.

The minigame uses individual pins and adjustable tension. Move the pick to a pin, lift it into position, and use controlled pressure to set it. Security pins introduce false sets and misleading clicks, so brute force is rarely the answer.

Default controls

  • Move the mouse left or right to change depth while the pick is lowered.
  • Move the mouse up or down to lift or lower the pick.
  • Hold A to apply tension.
  • While applying tension, use the mouse wheel or E / Q to adjust pressure.
  • Release tension to reset the pins, or press Escape to leave.

Bindings and a toggle-tension option are available in F12.

Every configured lock tier can be attempted at any skill level. Higher skill improves pin control and pick resilience. Learn through inspecting locks and attempting to pick them; failed attempts can also award XP.

Each set has five uses. Breaking a pick consumes one use. Excess force wears the pick during the raid, and cancelling does not repair that wear. Breaking a pick does not permanently break the door or stop its key from working. There is no countdown timer.

Default bonuses

  • Pin control improves by 0.5% per level.
  • Pick resilience improves by 0.75% per level.
  • Elite: an additional 10% expert control and resilience bonus.
Play YouTube video
Hacking

Craft a Modified PDA at Workbench level 2 and carry it to a supported electronic or keycard door to access the hacking interaction.

Explore the network, collect useful utilities, and overcome security defenses to complete the hack. Your coherence is your remaining endurance inside the minigame; losing it ends the attempt.

The PDA is reusable and also serves as your Signals Intelligence receiver.

Default settings

  • Three failed attempts allowed per door.
  • 60 starting coherence, plus 1 per skill level.
  • 20 starting attack strength, plus 1 for every five skill levels.
  • Three utility slots, increasing to four at elite.

Door availability, difficulty, and attempt limits are configurable. Use the Hacking practice mode to learn the mechanics before risking a raid attempt.

Signals Intelligence

Turn your Modified PDA into a receiver and follow transmissions to hidden supply caches.

  1. Carry the PDA into a raid and use its Open receiver inventory action.
  2. Tune a transmission and record a bearing.
  3. Move to another position and take further readings to narrow down the search area.
  4. Once you have a valid fix and enter the search area, use the receiver’s proximity audio to help locate the cache.
  5. Pair the PDA with the cache to unlock it and claim the contents.

The receiver’s beep cadence helps judge distance, while its pitch provides facing-direction guidance. Higher Signals Intelligence improves bearing accuracy and tuning tolerance. Collecting bearings and completing cache hunts awards skill XP.

Cache availability depends on the server’s enabled placements for the map you are playing. Factory is excluded, and maps without enabled placements do not generate caches. Administrators can customize placements and reward pools through the editor.

Try the Signals practice mode for a simulated receiver and pairing exercise without entering a raid.

NATO Weapon Proficiency

Improve your handling of weapons assigned to the NATO proficiency list by landing shots with them. Weapon assignments and XP sharing are configurable.

Default bonuses

  • Increases weapon ergonomics by 0.6% per level.
  • Reduces recoil by 0.4% per level.
Eastern Weapon Proficiency

Improve your handling of weapons assigned to the Eastern proficiency list by landing shots with them. Weapon assignments and XP sharing are configurable.

Default bonuses

  • Increases weapon ergonomics by 0.4% per level.
  • Reduces recoil by 0.3% per level.
Prone Movement

Move faster and more quietly while prone. Level this skill by moving while prone.

Default bonuses

  • Increases prone movement speed by 0.6% per level.
  • Reduces prone movement volume by 0.8% per level.
Silent Ops

Improve your quiet approach with faster melee attacks, quieter door actions, and cheaper suppressors. Progress through suppressed and melee kills.

Default bonuses

  • Increases melee speed by 0.5% per level.
  • Reduces door action volume by 1% per level.
  • Reduces trader suppressor prices by 0.5% per level.
First Aid

Get more out of your medkits. Level First Aid by treating wounds with them.

Default bonuses

  • Reduces medkit resource costs by 0.5% per level.
  • Increases medkit use speed by 0.6% per level.
Field Medicine

Improve your proficiency with injectors by using them.

Default bonuses

  • Raises the injector skill-bonus cap from its base of 60 by 0.5% per level.
  • Increases positive injector effect duration by 1% per level.
  • Improves the chance of positive injector effects by 0.5% per level.
Shadow Connections

There are shadowy figures all over T*****. Dealing with them has its benefits—if you survive.

Level Shadow Connections by killing cultists.

Default bonuses

  • Reduces Cultist Circle return time by 1% per level.
  • Reduces Scav cooldown by 1% per level.
  • Increases your chance of spawning as a Cultist Scav by 0.5% per level.
  • Elite: removes your Scav cooldown.
B*** Raw Power

Build on your B*** connections with better Prapor prices and increased quest XP rewards. Restricted to B* by default**; administrators can change the faction restriction.

Default bonuses

  • Reduces Prapor trading costs by 0.5% per level.
  • Increases quest XP rewards by 0.5% per level.
  • Elite: a 7% discount with all traders.
U*** Negotiations

Put your negotiating skills to work with better Peacekeeper prices and increased quest cash rewards. Restricted to U* by default**; administrators can change the faction restriction.

Default bonuses

  • Reduces Peacekeeper trading costs by 0.5% per level.
  • Increases quest money rewards by 0.5% per level.
  • Elite: a 7% discount with all traders.
